product.name: Slim Fit Linen Suit Pants
product.description: Slim-fit suit pants in airy linen with a fitted silhouette. Zip fly and concealed hook-and-eye fastening. Side pockets, welt back pockets, and creases. Fabric made from linen is breathable, looks great when ironed or wrinkled, and softens over time.
